title: Chapter 317 Zhao Bangde'S Strength
content:
Chapter 317 Zhao Bangde'S Strength

Zhao Bangde understood Wang Shuo's thoughts and generously showed his attributes to Wang Shuo.

[ID: SAC10010 Zhao Bangde]

[Level: Level 60 (Intermediate General)]

[Identity: Hedong County Governor]

[Combat Occupation: Boxer (Grandmaster)]

[Attack Power: 3200]

[Defense Power: 1400]

[Command Value: 500+20000]

[Health Value: 20000]

[Skills: ****]

Wang Shuo breathed a sigh of relief after seeing this.

At least in the top combat power, there are still people who can deal with the enemy's boss.

"What about our current military strength?"

Zhao Bangde smiled bitterly and sighed: "Shanhai City has only 100,000 troops, and there are only 4 junior generals at present. Counting the number of people who may come to support, I am afraid it will be less than 1 million people."

This is really a hell-level difficulty.

Wang Shuo was also deeply desperate.

At the beginning, the county governor, county magistrate, and mayor of each system town were only nominal superiors and subordinates.

And when they entered the game, the revival of the undead had already entered the countdown.

It can be said that there are internal and external troubles.

On the one hand, they must guard against the attack of the undead, and on the other hand, they must subdue their own subordinates.

And they must also be wary of these lords, who are both partners and potential enemies who can overthrow their rule.

The rulers of these system towns are even more difficult than the situation faced by the players.

This undead revival can be said to be a "monster siege" against them.

After leaving the county governor's mansion, Wang Shuo returned to the vicinity of the teleportation array.

At this time, more than half of the coalition forces in Changping County had been teleported over.

Wang Shuo immediately stationed the troops he brought with him in an open space near the east city gate in accordance with the unified arrangement of Shanhai City.

In the evening. All the troops have been teleported over.

Everyone saw that there were troops everywhere, and the whole Shanhai City was filled with a murderous atmosphere.

There were temporary military camps everywhere, and some lords who were originally arrogant were now much more respectful.

Wang Shuo led a group of generals to inspect the camp.

At this moment, Wang Shuo found Dongfang Ling.

She was dressed in military uniform, and her silver-white armor was shining.

Dongfang Ling also found Wang Shuo with a casual glance.

She was slightly startled, and immediately turned her head, and the two looked at each other.

It had been almost two months since the last meeting. Dongfang Ling had also experienced many things during this period, and her personality had undergone a huge change.

She was no longer a willful and capricious lady, but had grown into a lord who cared about the life and death of his subordinates.

However, when she saw Wang Shuo, she still felt a little ripple in her heart.

Wang Shuo nodded to her, and then turned around to continue inspecting his camp.

Dongfang Ling wanted to speak, but when she saw Wang Shuo turn around, her steps that were about to move forward suddenly stopped.

She stood there.

Her body stiffened.

The light in her eyes slowly disappeared.

Wang Shuo turned around casually... It seemed to close a door deep in Dongfang Ling's heart.

This turn... It seemed to be forever...

Dongfang Ling closed her eyes, took a deep breath, and then suddenly opened them.

The innocence of the girl had disappeared without a trace, and her face showed the face of a cold female general.

In the following days, lords led troops to teleport over one after another.

Wang Shuo stayed in the barracks and practiced for two days.

"Report, Commander Sauron of Shanhai City, please ask the county magistrate to go to discuss matters."

Wang Shuo has learned in the past few days that there are four major commanders in Shanhai City, namely Xie Xiaofeng, Sauron, Ba Huoyao, and Xu Qikai.

All four of them are junior warriors, responsible for defending four city gates respectively.

Wang Shuo was assigned to the command of Commander Sauron to defend the East Gate.

When Wang Shuo came to Commander Sauron's tent, there were already many people standing inside.

Roughly estimated, there should be no less than 50 people.

There are many lords who came alone with their troops, with less than 10,000 people.

There are also people like Wang Shuo who came as a coalition army, with tens of thousands of people under their command.

When almost everyone arrived.

Outside the big tent, a scarred man with three long swords on his back walked in.
